texts.facts: 3. The brief facts of the case are that the complainant - Shri B.N. Chaudhary, Food Inspector, Surat visited the shop of the accused M/s. Shital Provision Stores on 6.12.1994 at about 10:30 hrs., which is situated at Dolvan Char Rasta, Taluka: Vyara. That, the complainant gave his identity to accused and from there complainant took sample of "Black pepper" (whole). That the complainant purchased 600 GM black pepper and he also paid of Rs.50.40 paisa and sealed the sample, and sent to the Public Analyst- Bhuj. That, in the report of Public Analyst, Bhuj it was mentioned that the sample of the black pepper was adulterated and therefore complaint was lodged against the shop owner before the Judicial Magistrate First Class, Vyara, Surat. That, after hearing the parties, the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Vyara Surat was pleased to acquit the accused and therefore, the State has preferred this appeal.
